//: Generated by tools/fetch-detail.py from pack.json map.detail.bbox, then the woods layer was dropped by hand. Overpass returned 8563 forest polygons for this box, 4.9 MB of a 7.1 MB file that the service worker precaches, and on screen they are a faint speckle across a landscape whose subject is water. The fjord is what this pack needs and the fjord is in the land and lakes layers. map/basemap.js guards on d.paths.woods, so an absent layer is simply not drawn. Re-running fetch-detail.py brings them back; drop them again.
